# Changelog

All notable changes to PhysKit are documented here. The format follows Keep a Changelog and the project follows Semantic Versioning.

## [Unreleased]

## [0.1.0] - 2026-08-06

### Added

- Two-level API with the low-level `primitives` module and high-level `mechanics` and `vectors` modules.
- Vector geometry, named anchors, coordinate frames, directed ports, shapes, arrows, and surfaces.
- Boxes, pulleys, generic surfaces, floors, ceilings, walls, and inclined planes.
- `on-surface`, `fixed-to`, `align-rope-parallel`, and `suspended-from` constraints.
- Object-to-object ropes with automatic pulley tangencies and wrapping.
- Forces, weight helpers, and isolated free-body diagrams.
- Cartesian and polar vectors, component projections, axes, grids, and automatic resultants.
- Configurable labels for objects, ropes, and forces.
- Internal geometry kernel with vectors, orthonormal frames, directed ports and circle tangencies.
- Portuguese manual, standalone examples, regression tests, and GitHub Actions workflow.
